I told Ilse in our DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I took that from her own message to me on Oct 14.

The gbrain note I saved couldn't be read back. The brain refused because this bot's connection isn't tied to any member, so it can't read anyone's private notes. Our DM had the answer, so this didn't hold anything up. But private notes saved through gbrain won't be readable later until whoever runs the brain host ties this connection to a member.
